scope: finite-dimensional finite DAGs with multilinear laws and fixed labelled source directions
result: exact finite vector-valued source polynomial indexed by source multi-indices
repeated_source: supported; repeated use in two slots creates alpha_s=2
tree_reduction: tree subset expansion is recovered when sources are not reused

truncation.remainder: sum of norm-weighted omitted finite monomials

limitations: fixed numeric source directions with formal scalar amplitudes
finite exact polynomial only; no implicit infinite tail theorem
